items.message: Arbitrary code execution via installed entry points: `entry.load()` followed by `hook(Standards(...))` executes whatever function is registered under `in_lockstep.standards` in any installed package, with no signature validation, no sandbox, and no allowlist.
Entry-point `dist` metadata is trusted for display without sanitisation: `label` is constructed from `dist.name` and `dist.version` and printed verbatim by `ls`.
Test temporarily prepends a local example directory to `sys.path`, which persists for the duration of the test session if cleanup fails; not a production finding but worth noting for test isolation.
